validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, confirmed by THREE independent sources naming this exact corridor: (1) the Wayback-archived project catalogue of ОАО ИПП «ВНИПИТРАНСГАЗ» (VTG, the Soviet/Russian gas-transmission design institute that engineered most of the USSR's trunk network) lists a row 'Бильче Волица-Долина | 1400 mm | 7.4 MPa | 68 km | 1 line | Украина' verbatim; (2) Ukrainian Wikipedia's article on Прикарпаттрансгаз (the Ivano-Frankivsk regional gas-transport management unit) names 'Більче-Волиця-Долина' in its list of trunk pipelines built during that era, alongside DUD-I/II, 'Союз', and Urengoy-Pomary-Uzhgorod; (3) Ukrainian Wikipedia's 'Хронологія розвитку газової промисловості України' (chronology, sourced to Diyak/Osinchuk/Savkiv 2009 and Biletsky/Haiko/Orlovsky 2019) states under 1985: 'Уведено в експлуатацію газопроводи Єлець-Курськ-Диканька та Більче-Волиця-Долина' (brought into service in 1985). This is not a GEM-only entity and not a wiki-only claim — it independently pre-dates and does not derive from gem.wiki. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a domestic gas-transmission trunk line ('магистральный газопровід' per VTG's own heading), not a gathering/feeder line — no commodity/type issue. DUPLICATE CHECK against the 39-row roster: VTG's OWN catalogue lists 'Бильче Волица-Долина' (68 km, 1400mm) and 'Богородчаны-Долина' (42 km, 1400mm) as two SEPARATE rows feeding the same Dolyna hub from two different origins — this independently confirms P1462 is NOT a duplicate of P1463 (Bohorodchany-Dolyna). It is also clearly distinct from the much-longer, differently-dimensioned Ivatsevichy-Kobryn-Dolyna pair (P3484/P5938, 292 km, 1220mm, Belarus origin) and from the Torzhok-...-Dolyna transit line (P0779, 1300 km, 1420mm). No duplicate flag for this row. Note: LengthEstimateKm on the sheet (42.04 km) is the straight-line endpoint distance under the row's 'very low (straight line/schematic)' RouteAccuracy — this is expected to run well short of the true 68 km pipe length and is not itself evidence of a duplicate with P1463's 42 km declared length; RouteType='Mapped route (at any accuracy)' correctly agrees with RouteAccuracy='very low', no three-way-sync violation. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1 = 'Gas Transmission System Operator of Ukraine' at 100% is correct per the country-wide post-2020 TSOU rule (no Gazprom/Ukrtransgaz misattribution); Parent = 'Ministry of Energy (Ukraine)' at 100% is consistent with GTSOU's October 2023 transfer to state/ministry ownership. SPEC: Length=68.00 km and Diameter=1400mm are corroborated exactly by the VTG catalogue (the only source found with numeric specs for this specific segment — gem.wiki's own citation [1] for these figures is also this same VTG page, so this fill re-verifies rather than adds a wholly independent numeric source; tier is medium on that basis, not high). One sourcing-quality note for the record: gem.wiki attributes its '1985' start-year claim to the SAME VTG citation [1], but the archived VTG page contains no year at all for any pipeline — that specific gem.wiki citation does not actually support the 1985 date. I found independent, better support for 1985 via the two Wikipedia sources above, which is what is proposed in fills[] (GEM's own StartYearEarliest cell is currently blank, so no sheet value is contradicted — this is a genuine deep-fill, not a correction).

fills.researcher_notes: No dedicated 'still operating in 2026' news item exists for this specific domestic trunk segment (unsurprising for a stable Soviet-era line with no recent incident); no evidence of decommissioning either. Ref bundles the built-and-named confirmation (VTG) with current confirmation that TSOU actively operates Ukraine's GTS today (tsoua.com key facts). Marked medium, not high, because neither source is a pipeline-specific 2026 operational status statement.
VTG's catalogue lists it explicitly under 'газотранспортных сооружений' / 'магистральный газопровід' (gas trunk pipeline) — definitional confirmation of commodity.

VTG row: 'Бильче Волица-Долина | 1400 | 7,4 | 68 | 1 | Украина' — exact match on length. Single numeric source (also the source gem.wiki's own citation ultimately points to for this figure), so tier medium not high.
Same VTG row gives diameter 1400mm — exact match. Single numeric source, tier medium.

All three sources independently agree the corridor runs 'Більче-Волиця/Бильче Волица' -> 'Долина', both in Ukraine (Lviv Oblast -> Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast). Bilche-Volytsia is the site of the Bilche-Volytsko-Uherske UGS (Europe's largest); Dolyna is the Ivano-Frankivsk oblast gas-processing/compressor hub. High tier: three independent agreeing sources on the endpoints.

summary: P1462 (Bilche-Wolitz-Dolyna) confirmed real, correctly classified, correctly attributed (TSOU 100%), and not a duplicate of P1463/P3484/P5938 — VTG's own Soviet-era design-institute catalogue lists it as a distinct 68 km/1400mm/Ukraine row alongside a separate Bohorodchany-Dolyna row, and two Ukrainian Wikipedia sources independently name it and place its 1985 commissioning.
